g.text: div4 = s_q >> 2 when s_q[21] = 0, else (s_q + 3) >>> 2; clip to -128..127: p_hi selects 8'h7F, p_lo selects 8'h80; y = clipped + 128 (bit 7 inverted)
register (D flip-flops on clk rising edge)
name = net label (same name, same net)
